invocation_model: IN-PROCESS. authorities.py is the single source of the conformance/coverage/settlement math. It is no longer registered as UC Python functions and no longer invoked over a serverless SQL warehouse; the warehouse (Statement Execution API) has been removed from the operational adjudication path.
why: Each adjudication was ~5-6 warehouse round-trips (~7s warm, tens of seconds cold); the same pure functions run in-process in <1µs.
runtime_adapter: agent/src/authorities_runtime.py fetches spec_params/warranty_terms (Lakebase public) and the coil MTC (Lakebase reference: heats_coils + mill_test_certs) over the SAME psycopg 5432 path as retrieval/duplicate (db.py), with bound/parameterized queries, then calls authorities.compute_conformance/coverage/settlement in-process on the fetched inputs.
no_warehouse_in_runtime_path: grep of agent/src for statement_execution|execute_statement|warehouse|StatementState|.silver.compute_ finds only docstring/comment mentions noting the removal — no live warehouse call remains.
in_process_equals_fixtures: test_authorities.py (offline correctness fixtures, incl. zero-proration, exact warranty-duration boundary, over-claim, marine-denial) and test_authorities_runtime.py (adapter runs authorities in-process on fetched inputs) both pass; the adapter verdict equals the pure authority on the same inputs.
